description: Add Appliance Calculator page to estimate energy consumption and costs for common household appliances
steps: Create src/utils/applianceCalculator.ts with: preset appliances array (AC 1500W, Fan 75W, Refrigerator 200W, Washing Machine 500W, LED Light 10W, TV 100W), calculateMonthlyKWh function: (wattage * quantity * hoursPerDay * daysPerMonth) / 1000, and ApplianceItem interface

Create src/pages/ApplianceCalculator.tsx with: add appliance form (preset or custom wattage), quantity/hours/days inputs, per-appliance kWh and cost display (using Basic Flat normalRate = 7.20/kWh), bar chart of top consumers, energy-saving tips section
Add Appliance Calculator route to src/Router.tsx: /appliances
Create localStorage integration for appliance data: key 'wattwise_appliances'
Add navigation link to Appliance Calculator in landing page header and calculator page
Style matches application theme with consistent cards and layout
acceptance_criteria: Users can add, edit, and remove appliances
Calculations show accurate kWh and INR costs
Bar chart visualizes top energy-consuming appliances
Data persists across page reloads via localStorage
Page is accessible from main navigation
verification: Navigate to /appliances and add test appliances
Refresh page and verify data persists
